title: Chapter 296 Three-Way Cavalry Battle
content:
Chapter 296 Three-Way Cavalry Battle

Falati turned around and walked forward a few steps, then summoned a burning skeleton warhorse.

"Undead Knights, follow us to the battle."

...

Wang Shuo, who was still practicing in the tent, had not yet realized that danger had quietly arrived.

At this moment, Goode quickly walked in and reported: "Lord, according to the report from my men, there is a troop of tens of thousands of Undead Knights heading towards us."

Wang Shuo immediately stood up, his heart shocked.

Tens of thousands of people?

Nanshan will only have 6,000 people at most, and the Undead Knights are at least level 50 or above, which can be called an ace force.

I can't handle this myself!

Wang Shuo immediately reported the situation to Lin Xiaodong and contacted Su Xiu.

"Brother Su, there is a group of Undead Knights heading towards us."

"It seems that they are not friendly. Why don't we unite our forces first?"

Su Xiu also has a large number of scout knights, so he naturally got the news.

"Brother Wang, what you said is exactly what I want."

He was a little unsure about who this group of undead knights was targeting, but no matter who it was targeting, it would be fine as long as it was destroyed.

So the two of them brought their respective troops and joined together.

This was the first time that the two of them fought together, and at the same time, they both wanted to show their strength in front of each other to see who was the strongest lord in Changping County.

Su Xiu's cavalry all rode white horses, which were very tall and not much inferior to the flaming horses. Obviously, they were not ordinary war horses.

"Brother Wang, what do you think of my White Horse Knights?"

There were a total of 5,000 cavalrymen, all with uniform armor, weapons, and white horses, which were more imposing than Wang Shuo's 6,000 men.

"Brother Su, you have strong soldiers and horses, and your army is in full bloom. Your subordinates are like wolves and tigers, and your generals are like clouds. You are awesome!"

Su Xiu's face was full of pride, but after he saw Wang Shuo's Hell Knights and Golden Fire Cavalry, he also showed a solemn look.

The three-headed dogs of the Knights of Hell looked very fierce. The three dog heads could not be just for show. Even if they were biting, they could bite three people at the same time.

The Golden Fire Cavalry was covered with heavy armor, and the impact force could be imagined. If the White Horse Knights of the same number collided with them, they would have almost no chance of winning.

Su Xiu thought to himself that he was really good at becoming the first in Changping County, but he didn't know how many people were left in his two troops!

Wang Shuo and Su Xiu weighed each other's strength and began to discuss how to deal with the Knights of the Dead.

Neither of them thought about commanding other people's armies. After all, their strength seemed to be on par.

After the discussion, the two attacked from each side. Although they acted in unison, they commanded separately and fought against themselves.

Wang Shuo immediately placed his crossbow battalion above the mouth of the canyon in an eight-shaped shape and hid it. At the critical moment, it could be used as a backup.

If they were defeated, they would have a way out.

He had never thought of fighting to the death, and he was fighting with a strange friendly army. If the other party set him up, it would be terrible.

You should not have the intention to harm others, but you must be on guard against others.

Not long after, the figure of the Undead Knights appeared on the selected battlefield.

The three parties stood in a triangle.

The Undead Knights did not stop, and Wang Shuo and Su Xiu did not dare to neglect it. They quickly asked the cavalry to move. The combat effectiveness of the cavalry without speed would be greatly reduced.

The rumbling sound of horse hooves resounded through the sky, and the battle was about to break out.

This was the largest cavalry battle so far.
